budget-sum.applicability: Arithmetic checks on an existing BOM CSV with understood headers and commercial scope.
limitations: Does not validate price evidence, tax, warranty, delivery or implementation completeness.
budget-sum.excluded_reason: The CSV header contract and arithmetic-only meaning must be explicit before this can be a public budget command.

hci-failover.description: HCI N+1 capacity and failure-domain validation
hci-failover.applicability: Only after project requirements independently justify evaluating HCI.
limitations: Does not decide whether HCI is required or validate vendor-specific implementation details.

historian.description: SCADA historian storage from measured point/sample assumptions
historian.applicability: Historian sizing from historical point count, effective sample period and explicit retention assumptions.
limitations: Compression and record-size assumptions require vendor validation or field measurement.

network-ports.description: Access ports, uplinks, management ports and spare capacity
network-ports.applicability: Access-port quantity and basic Layer-3 ownership checks from explicit endpoint assumptions.
limitations: Does not size switching throughput, PoE budget, optics or physical redundancy.

server-capacity.description: CPU and memory estimate for service or virtualization workloads
server-capacity.applicability: Transparent estimates after the physical-server or virtualization mode is already known.
limitations: Mixed service and VM modes currently lack a versioned input contract and an explicit mode gate.
server-capacity.excluded_reason: Expose only after mode selection and structured service inputs can be validated without encouraging VM formulas for standalone servers.

storage.description: RAID usable capacity and retention sizing
storage.applicability: RAID arithmetic and retention headroom from explicit drive and growth assumptions.
limitations: Does not model performance, rebuild risk, filesystem overhead or independent backup.

tco.applicability: Cost comparison among candidates that have already passed mandatory technical and compliance gates.
limitations: Does not establish technical eligibility or replace current-price evidence.

ups.description: UPS W/VA target and candidate technical gate
ups.applicability: UPS capacity target and candidate eligibility from an explicit protected load and runtime objective.
limitations: Actual runtime must be verified against the manufacturer curve at the protected load.

server-quotes-compare.description: Budget control range from validated independent server quotes
server-quotes-compare.applicability: Comparison of exact server quotations against a frozen RFQ baseline.
limitations: A generic run must not bypass the server RFQ contract or supplier-independence checks.
server-quotes-compare.excluded_reason: Requires a dedicated server-quotes command that always performs current server-rfq preflight.

vendor-compare.applicability: Project-specific comparison after mandatory requirements and evidence-backed scores are supplied.
limitations: User-supplied scores and evidence currently have no versioned input contract.
vendor-compare.excluded_reason: Keep outside generic run until its decision inputs are contract-validated and output writes are non-overwriting.

contracts-library.description: Shared validation helpers for risk-sensitive workflows
limitations: It has no user-facing command contract.
contracts-library.excluded_reason: Internal library module; executing it directly performs no supported workflow.

architecture-evaluation.applicability: Architecture checks after availability, connectivity and workload requirements are explicit.
limitations: Absent fields remain unresolved; input is not yet a versioned architecture contract.
architecture-evaluation.excluded_reason: Do not expose until missing mandatory facts remain explicitly unresolved under a versioned contract.

release-notes-extractor.description: Extract one version section from the changelog for release automation
release-notes-extractor.applicability: Maintainer release-note assembly from repository changelog content.
limitations: It is a release-maintenance utility and an explicit output path may be overwritten.
release-notes-extractor.excluded_reason: Maintainer-only release command; it is unrelated to project infrastructure calculations.

bom-generator.applicability: Rendering a reviewed structured BOM into CSV.
limitations: Draft and RFQ may retain TBD prices; amount-complete is not procurement-ready. New output by default; --force explicitly replaces.
bom-generator.excluded_reason: File-producing renderer with an unversioned BOM input; use its explicit standalone CLI and stage.

tender-spec-generator.applicability: Rendering reviewed mandatory, recommended and optional requirements.
limitations: Input structure is unversioned and an explicit output path may be overwritten.
tender-spec-generator.excluded_reason: Keep outside generic run until input validation and non-overwrite output semantics are enforced.

topology-generator.description: Mermaid or Graphviz logical topology generator
topology-generator.applicability: Rendering an already-decided logical topology from explicit zones, devices and links.
limitations: Does not decide architecture and may overwrite an explicit output path.
topology-generator.excluded_reason: Keep outside generic run until its input contract and non-overwrite output policy are explicit.

requirements-guide.applicability: Finding high-value missing requirements before architecture or product decisions.
limitations: Scenario suggestions are assumptions, not project facts or predefined architectures.
requirements-guide.excluded_reason: Use a dedicated guide command so the discovery-only boundary and template handling remain explicit.

infra-cli.applicability: Discovering, validating and running explicitly exposed deterministic tools.
limitations: It is an entry point, not a calculator and not an Agent research substitute.
infra-cli.excluded_reason: The dispatcher cannot invoke itself through run.

skill-installer.description: Cross-platform Skill installation and update utility
skill-installer.applicability: Explicit user-authorized installation or update of the Skill.
limitations: May modify host discovery directories and update a Git checkout.
skill-installer.excluded_reason: Host-mutating lifecycle operations must remain an explicit standalone command.

schema-migration.applicability: Supported v1-to-v2 price-evidence and retrospective migrations.
limitations: Migration must not invent decision scope, PASS, Verified, zero or current dates.
schema-migration.excluded_reason: Use a dedicated migration command that preserves source files and refuses output overwrite.

price-evidence.description: Price-evidence normalization and guarded budget revision
price-evidence.applicability: Evidence normalization after technical fit, decision scope and commercial facts are explicit.
limitations: Legacy or unversioned inputs can bypass schema preflight when the direct script is explicitly invoked.
price-evidence.excluded_reason: A public wrapper must force strict versioned contracts and must not expose legacy-input bypass.

schema-validator.applicability: Preflight validation against bundled named contracts.
limitations: Schema validity does not prove engineering suitability or evidence truth.
schema-validator.excluded_reason: Already exposed through the named validate command; arbitrary validator execution is unnecessary.

release-validator.description: Release metadata and runtime manifest validator
limitations: It validates repository packaging metadata, not project infrastructure inputs.

project-records-library.description: Project record semantics and explicit-path helpers
project-records-library.applicability: Imported by project delivery and Draw.io tools.
limitations: Does not verify real-world evidence or prevent hostile concurrent filesystem mutation.
project-records-library.excluded_reason: Internal library; no supported direct command.

project-record-validator.description: Read-only project evidence, delivery and acceptance consistency
project-record-validator.applicability: Explicit project record validation with family-specific preflight.
limitations: Checks declared projections, not original document content or evidence truth.
project-record-validator.excluded_reason: Use infra_cli project-check or the standalone family command.

drawio-tools.description: Draw.io draft adapter and presentation-only semantic guard
drawio-tools.applicability: Explicit Draw.io creation/check/compare; create requires a path manifest.
limitations: No rendering, CAD geometry conversion or automatic interpretation of style-encoded engineering meaning; compressed XML must first be exported uncompressed.
drawio-tools.excluded_reason: Use the explicit standalone subcommand; not a generic calculator.

server-quote-validator.description: Server quotation validation against a frozen RFQ baseline
server-quote-validator.applicability: Technical and commercial validation of server quotations before price comparison.
limitations: V1 is a coarse minimum gate; exact-configuration claims require server-rfq-v2.
server-quote-validator.excluded_reason: Requires a dedicated server-quotes command that always performs current server-rfq preflight.
